qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/raw-evidence-index.json (scope header only: scripted golden evidence, no configured judge run)
evidence:
Runtime-contract half is satisfied. Entry path and start command: instruction.md:5 ('Put the app in /app and serve the workspace at /') and environment/instructions/integration.md:3 ('We start it with node /app/server.js from a working directory that may be outside /app ... Listen on 0.0.0.0:3000 ... answer GET /api/health promptly'). Storage: integration.md:9 ('Use SQLite ... default database path is /app/app.db. If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead, including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app'), which matches tests/test.sh:97-111 (APP_COPY fallback, PORT=3000, DB_PATH=$APP_DB). Dependencies: integration.md:5 (Node 22, Express, better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH; no install or build step). Seed: instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 (/assets/seed_data.json, no user snippets). Accounts: instruction.md:5 ('without signing in'), policy.md:3, consistent with tests/app_context.md:10. Symlink rule in test.sh:72-83 is stated at integration.md:11. Fixed clock: none exists in seed, test.sh or criteria, so there is nothing to state (the five-second run budget is stated at behaviour.md:5). Restart persistence used by restart_app is stated at integration.md:7,9 and behaviour.md:9.

Deliverables half has two graded demands with no public requirement. (1) tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:47 (cw_grapheme_navigation_and_deletion, weight 1.0 of 54) requires 'Shift+Arrow must select it whole, confirmed by the copied or highlighted text'. Keyboard range selection is never asked for: ui.md:5 lists 'normal typing, paste, new lines, Backspace, Delete, arrows, Home and End' and says emoji and accented letters 'should move and delete as complete visible characters'; ui.md:7 defines selection only through mouse actions (click, double click, triple click, drag). A grep of instruction.md and all six notes for 'shift' finds only 'Shift+Tab' (ui.md:7). (2) tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23 (cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus, 1 of 6 polish criteria) fails the app 'if keyboard focus is trapped inside the code editor with no working way out'. The only public statements are ui.md:17 'Label controls clearly and show keyboard focus' and ui.md:7 which makes Tab and Shift+Tab indent and outdent inside the editor. No note asks for a keyboard exit from the editor; the golden supplies one by its own convention (solution/app/src/custom-editor.js:251-256, Escape then Tab). qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md 'No hidden requirements' names 'keyboard escape conventions' explicitly as something to check against public instructions.

Everything else graded was traced to a public sentence: gates (ui.md:3, behaviour.md:9, integration.md:7), editing, multi-caret, undo, find and replace, colouring, formatting (ui.md:5-15), preview, errors, budget, stop, supersede (behaviour.md:3-7), isolation and dynamic evaluation (security.md:3-5), save, conflict, live refresh, history and restore (behaviour.md:9-13), polish items (ui.md:9,17), visual (overview.md:3, ui.md:17). Weaker but tolerable links, recorded as observations rather than defects for this row: judge.toml:137 expects the Find match to be 'a real selection' with the line readout following it while ui.md:11 only says 'next and previous matches'; judge.toml:308 asks the judge to 'record its identity' while no note asks for the identity to be shown.

No configured judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index.json scope: 'Scripted golden behaviour evidence only'), so the effect on a model score is not measured.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that fails: an app that implements every sentence of ui.md, including mouse click, double click, triple click and drag selection, grapheme-aware ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Backspace and Delete, and Tab and Shift+Tab indenting, but does not extend a selection on Shift+Arrow and keeps Tab inside the editor with no exit shortcut. It violates no public sentence, yet loses cw_grapheme_navigation_and_deletion (judge.toml:47, even though its emoji and accent movement and deletion are correct) and cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus (polish/judge.toml:23, even though every control outside the editor is Tab-reachable with visible focus). Estimated cost about 0.6 * 1/54 + 0.2 * 1/6 = 0.044 of the reward, not measured by a run.
suggested_fix: Either state both behaviours publicly or stop grading them. Preferred: in environment/instructions/ui.md add to line 5 that Shift with the arrow keys, Home and End extends a selection, and to line 17 that keyboard users must be able to leave the code editor for the next control without a mouse, with the way to do so shown in the app. Alternative: drop the Shift+Arrow clause from judge.toml:47 and the trapped-focus clause from polish/judge.toml:23. Any such change makes a new candidate and invalidates the current clearance.
